main_measure.name: mean of forecast x excess 3-bar return on positive-forecast grid bars
main_measure.threshold: t >= 2 (with supporting check > 0) confirms; t <= -2 rejects; at least 100 cases

supporting_check.name: mean excess 3-bar return, upper minus lower half at median forecast

decided_by: the main measure's t is 2 or more and the supporting check is above 0, with at least 100 cases.
reading: The coin's mean 3-bar return is taken over all its windows' non-overlapping grid returns (grid from each window's first row, last incomplete cell dropped), and the median split puts forecasts above the median in the upper half and those at or below it in the lower half.

direction_check.why: no check fold (the plan has none, or the backtest did not run on its folds)
